purpose: Hash-pinned visual review of a verified source image before raw benchmark use or derivative sanitization planning.
approval_rules: Review source SHA-256 must exactly match the verified source image used by the benchmark/challenge queue.
approved_raw requires identity_match=true, primary_figure_complete=true, no visible text leakage, no visual confounders, sanitization_action=none, and raw_model_input_allowed=true.
sanitization_required requires raw_model_input_allowed=false and a non-none sanitization action.
A changed source hash makes the review stale and incapable of authorizing model input.
Reviewer provenance is recorded at review-set level and model/hybrid reviewers must record model family/revision where available.
Review metadata does not make derivative pixels approved; sanitized derivatives still require the separate exact-hash derivative review gate.
